svg.title: Platform-XP-EKS Composition Flowchart
svg.desc: Crossplane XRD composition pipeline for self-service EKS clusters
svg.text: creates ProviderConfig only (IRSA cross-account role chain)
creates urukube-argocd-role — trust-only, no permissions policy, fixed external-name
NodeRole + ClusterRole, optional iamPermissionsBoundaryArn on both
EKS Cluster + kube-proxy addon + AccessEntries (node role · adminRoleArns · argocd-role)
LaunchTemplate + AutoscalingGroup; SGIngressRules once cluster SG is observed
patches clusterName · clusterEndpoint · oidcProviderArn/IssuerUrl · CA data onto status
conditional — once cluster reports endpoint+CA: registers cluster with ArgoCD
Secret in argocd namespace on orchestrator
SecurityGroupIngressRules ×N (conditional — only after cluster SG is observed)
ec2.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1 · one rule per subnetCidr · HTTPS 443 → cluster primary SG
